title: Foxess inverter — error 21
content: Grid overvoltage. Check AC voltage at the breaker; above 253V the inverter disconnects by regulation. Ask the utility for a tap adjustment if it persists.

title: Deye F58 alarm
content: Ground fault on the DC side. Inspect string insulation and MC4 connectors for moisture.

title: PAC opening rules
content: Open a PAC when the fault requires a field visit or manufacturer RMA. Attach photos of the display and the plate.
